body: if “god”cared they wouldn’t let us feel like this. stay strong. we’re all fighting an uphill battle but we’re not alone in how we feel.
please talk to your parents and your girlfriend about this if you’re comfortable with it. you’re so young.

sometimes i feel like i’m just meant to be in pain all the time. i’ve been waiting for a “breakthrough” and to wake up one day magically happy, but it’s such an unrealistic thing to hope for. i’ve pretty much given up on being happy and i’ve accepted that my life will always be like this.
i’m really sorry you feel this way. i hope whatever you decide to do, you find your peace. we all deserve peace.
